basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer from Austin, Texas. I've recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and currently work as a junior web developer. My interests mainly revolve around gaming, especially RPGs and action-adventure games like Dark Souls and Sekiro. I also enjoy watching gaming streams and participating in online gaming communities. I'm single and usually spend my evenings and weekends online, either gaming or browsing Reddit. I'm still figuring out my footing on Reddit but enjoying the journey.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in video games and have been playing them since I was a teenager. Most of my knowledge comes from personal experience and online tutorials. I also have a background in computer science, which occasionally helps when delving into the technical aspects of gaming.
